snippet.title: Tung Tung Tung Sahur Nightmare - All Endings & Full Walkthrough (Showcase)
snippet.description:
This Tungtung's Nightmare game is inspired by the brainrot meme Tung tung tung Sahur from Indonesia. In this meme, if someone doesn’t wake up for sahur, they will be terrorized by a creature called Tungtung.

00:00 - Tungtung's Nightmare
03:06 - Bad Ending
06:11 - Good Ending
